title: Read-only Production runtime and Hostinger environment key inventory

phases.objective: Read only environment key names from the live Production process and Hostinger Node.js environment inventory so an existing canonical key can be selected instead of creating a duplicate or replaying masked provider values.

e2e_journeys.actor: Repository owner through an exact Production-SHA-bound GitHub Actions read-only workflow
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Evidence proves whether DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT already exists in the live runtime and Hostinger provider configuration, detects duplicate key names, and emits no environment values or secrets.
steps: Verify the requested SHA equals the current protected Production branch head before credential use.
Read runtime process environment key names through the existing backend-key-authenticated Admin env list action with values disabled.
Read Hostinger Node.js environment variables with the official GET endpoint using the existing HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN.
Reject provider evidence if any environment value is returned unmasked.
Retain only identity-like key names, presence, counts, and duplicate-name evidence.
Classify the canonical DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT key as update_existing_key when present or create_missing_key_once when absent.
assertions: No environment value is requested from the runtime process.
Hostinger provider values must remain masked and are discarded before evidence is emitted.
The workflow performs GET-only provider access and no provider mutation.
No Production runtime mutation, restart, deployment, database mutation, migration apply, grant apply, repository mutation, or secret disclosure occurs.
DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT is the only canonical key selected for the Hostinger runtime-class fix; NODE_ENV and REMOTE_MCP_ENVIRONMENT remain diagnostic alternatives only.
